verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state three schedule types—Scheduled (interval-based, sub-hour possible), Cron (user-defined cron expressions), and Manual triggers—giving per-connection control of sync frequency (airbyte-docs-8, -30, -35, -53). Pricing page also references '15-minute syncs' confirming sub-hour scheduling support (airbyte-docs-50). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of sub-hour interval limits/reliability beyond docs.
